title: kbs now JIT real summaries fail-closed
description:
Production `kbs now` must generate just-in-time real summaries from the LLM pipeline. Never emit placeholder or mock strings. Fail closed when generation cannot produce a real summary (missing API key, LLM error, validation failure).

Scope:
- JIT real summaries only; no canned fallbacks
- Fail-closed behavior on any generation failure
- Purge clears only `right_now_summary` and `right_now_updated_at`, including `virtual_projects`
- SD acceptance on `/workspace/projects-meta`
